violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING MORNING PREP

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed an open can of energy drink being stored on top of the clean-side drain board of the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC DISCARDED THE BEVERAGE

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 3DR prep top Burger cooler: sliced turkey (45f), rice (44f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed two cans of home-use pesticides being stored at the bar
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE PESTICIDES. IF YOU NOTICE AN INCREASE PEST PRESENCES, CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TO SERVICES.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed Murphy Oil Soap being stored next to beverages, salt and cups
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE SOAP TO CHEMICAL STORAGE

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of water along the cook line
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL THE BOTTLES.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: PIC has an expired Certified Food Manager certificate.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. RENEW CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS CERTIFICATE.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed PIC take burger buns out of a plastic bag with his bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIC DISCARDED THE BUNS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed several bottles of over-the-counter pain medication being stored on a shelf with other food-related items at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS TO THE FIRST-AID AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the bar hand sink and the hand sink next to the salad prep cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PUT PAPER TOWELS AT EACH HAND SINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: In the 2DWR under grill cooler, Raw chicken and Raw burger patties were being stored above cooked ribs and Raw salmon
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN AND RAW BURGER PATTIES TO THE BOTTOM DRAWER. PIC MOVED THE COOKED RIBS AND RAW SALMON TO THE TOP DRAWER.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing dish machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION. WASHING AND RINSING CAN OCCUR IN THE DISH MACHINE. SANITIZING MUST OCCUR IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK DISHES FOR 30-60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. PIC CALLED SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR MACHINE. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 06/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) unsalted butter was observed at 47f in the server station ice well; 2) in the 2DR under counter cooler at the bar, milk was observed at 48f and chocolate milk was observed 47f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE BUTTER AND MILKS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: Observed pink and black discoloration inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE ICE MACHINE UNTIL IT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED. PIC STATES HE WILL EMPTY AND CLEAN THE ICE MACHINE LATER TODAY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DR sliding glass cooler for servers was observed at 46f-47f; 2) 2DR under counter cooler at the bar was observed at 48f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE REPAIR COOLERS. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET BETWEEN 32f-38f.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The basins of the two hand sinks located at the dish washing area were observed full of water.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR THE HAND SINK TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the grilll line being used to rinse off utensils. Observed hanadsink at the bar area being used to store soda fountain plugs.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC instructed staff to not use the handsinks for anything other than hand washing.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: EHS observed fish and chicken breading station being held on time without a 4 hour endpoint
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC marked breading stations with a 4 hour endpoint. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 12/18/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: EHS observed no thermometers in the 3 door prep top on cook line and the 3 door prep top across from the fryer.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced thermometers in cold holding units.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. EHS observed wiping cloths soaked in sanitizer solution on the cook line being stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC instructed staff to store cloths in sanitizer solution buckets.
